scientific_claim: Under the frozen WBG-5 controlled raw-byte grammar, Wingless learned all eight level-1 motifs and all four two-motif compounds, generalized the factorized long-range reference relation perfectly to exact compound-pair families absent from training, reduced effective heldout grammar events by 43.75%, and did so within the fixed 16-structure hierarchy with zero oracle-boundary use, leakage, or capacity growth. Motif-only and shuffled-compound controls scored zero long-range accuracy.
program_interpretation: The complete WBG-1 through WBG-5 adaptive-granularity ladder is supported in the tested synthetic regime: native raw-byte acquisition, causal motif induction, uncertainty-adaptive granularity, cross-domain transfer, and a bounded multiscale language-like hierarchy have each passed frozen gates.
next_question: Integrate the qualified Wingless raw-byte hierarchy with the qualified Yggdrasil developmental specialization/hibernate/regenerate machinery and test whether the same learned predictive structures can be developmentally maintained under lesion and domain shift without an external model.
scope: bounded synthetic multiscale raw-byte language precursor; not open-domain language competence
